outcome: Overall survival rate at NICU discharge
Survival rate of patients who received ECMO
Baseline oxygenation index before ECMO cannulation
Serum lactate levels before ECMO cannulation
cohort: The study included 322 infants with congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) treated at a tertiary center over a 16-year period.
finding: The multidisciplinary ECMO team approach (META) significantly improved the overall survival rate of newborn infants with CDH, including a notable improvement among patients who received ECMO.
mod_finding: The group receiving the multidisciplinary ECMO team approach (P2) had a significantly higher rate of cesarean section compared to the pre-META group (P1).
